name: Inari
storyline:
For generations, the High Realm has sought to dominate the mortal world. Now, you have been chosen to enforce their will. You are Izuna, Executor of the High Realm—known to mortals as the Reaper.

Your mission: hunt down and eliminate the Seven Daughters, princesses who dared to defy the heavens. Your first target awaits at the Bronze Citadel—Princess Ikane's domain, where mortal technology has reached its apex.

Colossal gears and machinery grind endlessly, while troops and traps stand ready to crush all intruders.

But you cannot waver.
The Lord's will is absolute, and failure is not an option.
summary: INARI is a high-speed kunai action platformer set in an Eastern fantasy world. You are an executioner sent to hunt down the Seven Daughters who dared defy the mighty Lord. Engage in rapid, relentless combat using kunai and instant teleportation. Face overwhelming odds with a single life.
